job.title: Front End Cashier (Part-Time)
description: Piedmont Fresh Market is a neighborhood grocery store with a full-service deli, bakery and in-store pharmacy. We're hiring part-time Front End Cashiers for our Plaza Midwood store.

* Handle cash, cards, SNAP/EBT and coupons, and balance your till at the end of each shift
* Bag groceries carefully and offer carry-out help
* Keep your lane and the front end clean, stocked and safe
* Help with returns and price checks and call a supervisor when needed
* Customer service experience preferred (retail, restaurant or volunteer all count)
* Able to stand for up to 8 hours and lift 25 lbs
* Flexible availability, including weekends and some holidays
Part-time, 20–30 hours per week. Shifts between 7 AM and 10 PM. $15.00 per hour, 10% employee discount.
